classificationNotes: Source-draft Treants are treated as a walking-tree visual and encounter-production family. Claims about age, status, society, cognition, agency, personhood, habitat, and universal behavior remain proposals pending taxonomy review. Ordinary tree material, roots, moss, water, and caught stone are family-native botany and history, not affinity labels.
visualConstants: Vertical trunk body, root-cluster legs, long branch arms, a bark-suggested face, and canopy remain recognizable.
Bark brown and grey, moss green, autumn gold, sap, and restrained amber heartwood remain botanical materials.
Nests, vines, mushrooms, bark runes, scars, and growth rings record age without replacing readable joints.
Girth, canopy, rooted reach, and resident ecosystems escalate while branch load and root commitment preserve counterplay.
escalationAxis: Age and ecosystem load turn simple root movement into canopy control and finally a sovereign walking forest that reconfigures the arena.

constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity tree anatomy, ordinary wood, roots, moss, amber heartwood, the T5 waterfall, and stone in the roots remain botanical, weathered, or carried source motifs—not retired Wood affinity, Earth affinity, or Water affinity.
Sap, lichen, leaves, nests, mushrooms, bark scars, growth rings, and ordinary gravity-driven water remain restrained natural details with no elemental substitution.
normal.counterplaySignal: The established shallow root, branch load, vine knot, heartwood cavity, or sovereign root-grove anchor remains visible.
forbidden: Presenting ordinary wood, moss, waterfall, or stone as an affinity

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves; T4 alone gains the source-supported heartwood cavity; T5 alone carries its waterfall, boulders, and groves.
Char-controlled bark plates, resin fuel channels, ember-pruned branch tips, directional smoke vents, and blackened firebreak seams add combustion while preserving living growth.
fire.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves, so a resin channel exposes a root seam; T4 heartwood cavity opens after venting; T5 waterfall, boulders, and groves reveal one firebreak root when the canopy burns.

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves; T4 alone gains the source-supported heartwood cavity; T5 alone carries its waterfall, boulders, and groves.
Compressed mineral root shoes, sediment bark laminates, crystal load knots, localized dust, and pale faults alter weight without treating native caught stones as affinity.
earth.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves, so a planted mineral root exposes a fracture; T4 heartwood cavity opens after a loaded stomp; T5 waterfall, boulders, and groves strain one crystal-bound root arch.
forbidden: Treating ordinary stones in roots as Earth affinity

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves; T4 alone gains the source-supported heartwood cavity; T5 alone carries its waterfall, boulders, and groves.
Directional leaf vanes, hollow branch flutes, aligned vine streamers, canopy pressure planes, and a still trunk center make force routes visible.
wind.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves, so the still trunk center exposes a root; T4 heartwood cavity pauses between gusts; T5 waterfall, boulders, and groves align around one still canopy anchor.

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves; T4 alone gains the source-supported heartwood cavity; T5 alone carries its waterfall, boulders, and groves.
Pressurized sap-water channels, wet bark reflection, coherent root conduits, mist valves, and visible drainage add hydraulic behavior beyond ordinary rain or the native T5 waterfall.
water.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves, so pressure loss opens a root valve; T4 heartwood cavity drains after release; T5 waterfall, boulders, and groves expose one supply root when its conduit empties.
forbidden: Treating the native waterfall as Water affinity

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe close footwork with one shallow-root lash.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the thin trunk must plant one shallow root before a branch can whip.
forms.signatureMechanic: Shallow Plant: one root foot spreads and the opposite whip-like branch sweeps its narrow arc.
forms.telegraph: Few leaves turn edge-on while one shallow root fans across the ground.
forms.counterplay: Cross behind the planted root and strike the thin trunk before it pulls free.
forms.visualDelta: Thin whip-like trunk, few leaves, shallow root feet, and a face barely suggested in bark.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Repeat frontal pressure with a mature canopy and alternating root-braced shoves.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that moss compression marks the loaded shoulder and opposite root opening.
forms.signatureMechanic: Moss Brace: shoulder moss compresses as one branch arm and matching root perform a reliable shove.
forms.telegraph: The proper leaf canopy tilts and moss darkens over the loaded shoulder.
forms.counterplay: Move to the dry shoulder and punish the lifted opposite root after the shove.
forms.visualDelta: Thicker trunk, rough bark, mossed shoulders, a proper leaf canopy, and clearer branch arms.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Sapling-walkers lash from its shaded side; breaking the brace exposes both roots.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a controller that braids hanging vines between heavy roots to define one moving safe lane.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach players to follow vine knots rather than canopy size and cut the single load-bearing braid.
forms.signatureMechanic: Root Loom: two arm vines knot to one heavy root, drawing foliage walls together while the unknotted lane remains open.
forms.telegraph: The clear bark face looks toward one root as two hanging vines twist around it.
forms.counterplay: Take the unknotted lane and cut the visible braid at the selected root to drop both foliage walls.
forms.visualDelta: Broad oak-form, heavy root legs, dense foliage, hanging vines, and a clear bark face; still no hollow cavity.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Young Treants brace a wall; breaking their Moss Brace slackens one vine immediately.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control alternating habitats by opening an amber heartwood cavity that directs birds, mushrooms, and vine screens.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that resident life announces which ancient limb is active and leaves the cavity open after command.
forms.signatureMechanic: Hollow Council: birds leave one branch, mushrooms brighten at one root, and a vine screen grows between them before the cavity releases amber sap.
forms.telegraph: The hollow trunk opens, amber heartwood pulses, and residents move toward the selected branch-root pair.
forms.counterplay: Cross outside the marked pair and strike the open heartwood cavity after the sap release.
forms.visualDelta: Ancient hollow trunk with amber heartwood cavity, nesting birds, and mushrooms along the base.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Oakheart vine knots stabilize the screen; cutting their braid shortens the command.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Transform a four-grove arena by rerouting a back waterfall through boulder-bound roots and commanding learned lower-form habitats.
forms.teachingGoal: Test root planting, canopy loads, vine lanes, and heartwood timing while every solved grove becomes permanently traversable.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Transformation — Four Seasonal Groves: the waterfall feeds one shoulder grove, boulders lock its root arch, and a lower form performs its learned rule there; resolving it exposes the supply root and drains that grove into a safe path.
forms.telegraph: Waterfall flow bends toward one shoulder grove, its caught boulders grind, and the matching lower-form marker appears beneath the sky-filling canopy.
forms.counterplay: Answer the called lower-form lesson, then sever the exposed supply root; each drained grove removes one command and opens the sovereign trunk.
forms.visualDelta: Walking forest with a waterfall down its back, boulders caught in roots, sky-filling canopy, and entire groves on its shoulders.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Sapling-walker, Young Treant, Oakheart, and Elder Warden each govern one grove; solving that form's lesson permanently drains its route.
